field.name: $saveFirstViewer
field.viewer: <> {_t('Save the control type to configure its fields.')}

field.name: $formulaHelpViewer
field.viewer:
<>

{_t('A control type describes what is controlled and how.')}

{_t('In the field table above there are two usages')}:

  • {_t('the fields with the usage "control plan" carry the reference values configured in the control plans')}
  • {_t('the fields with the usage "control entry" carry the value measured by the operator on each sample of the control entry')}

{_t('The formula defines how the control entry is checked against those fields. It is evaluated when the operator clicks "Check conformity" in the control entry and must return')} true {_t('(compliant) or')} false {_t('(not compliant)')}.

{_t('The fields')}

{_t('Each field has a code (the technical name used in the formula), a name (displayed in the application) and a type. They are read in the formula as')} plan.code {_t('and')} entry.code. {_t('A decimal field gives a number, a text field a character string, a boolean field true or false, and a selection field the selected value, whose label is read with')} .name.

{_t('Formula examples')}

  • return plan.acceptedColor == entry.currentColor; {_t('(simple equality between the two fields)')}
  • return (entry.mesuredDim >= plan.acceptedDimension - plan.minTolerance) && (entry.mesuredDim <= plan.acceptedDimension + plan.maxTolerance); {_t('(the measured value must be within the tolerance interval around the nominal value)')}
  • return !plan.isLabelRequired || entry.isLabelPresent; {_t('(checks that the boolean field isLabelPresent is true, that is that the operator ticked the box)')}

{_t('A field flagged as required blocks the conformity check while its value is empty.')}

action-view.name: action-quality-control-type-field-view-plan-fields
action-view.title: Control plan fields
action-view.domain: self.usageSelect = 1 AND self.id IN (SELECT f.id FROM ControlType t JOIN t.controlTypeFieldSet f WHERE t.id = :_controlTypeId)

action-view.name: action-quality-control-type-field-view-entry-fields
action-view.title: Control entry fields
action-view.domain: self.usageSelect = 2 AND self.id IN (SELECT f.id FROM ControlType t JOIN t.controlTypeFieldSet f WHERE t.id = :_controlTypeId)
